g.text: Semi-transparent individual earners with weighted 5-year age band conditional means
Annual Earnings in Urban KP Rise Across Career Lifecycle, Peaking at Ages 55–59
Source: PSLM 2019–20. Sample: Earners aged 15–64 in KP Urban (N = 678). Weighted by hhweight.
Hollow marker indicates thin band with fewer than 30 unweighted observations (band 60–64, N = 15).
Individual observations jittered horizontally by ±0.35 years (alpha = 0.35) to mitigate overplotting.
